note: Each shot is 854x480 (art drawn at 2x the game's pixel size). Show a 270x480 window and pan it sideways by panX (from -> to, in px, left edge of the window).

2.direction: pan back left while the keep sinks; shake and lightning flashes in code

3.direction: hold on the anvil and dying forge; bubbles, light rays and the falling hammer in code

4.direction: slow pan right as the eyes open one by one

eyes.frames: 3 frames of 8x2 (scale 1) or 16x4 (scale 2): closed, half, open
eyes.timing: open one pair every ~0.6 s, last one is closest

5.direction: hold; boat sprite glides up from the bottom, fog layers drift in code

boat.anchor: bottom-centre of the sprite (the hull waterline), in shot-image pixels (854x480)
boat.scaleNote: scale down with NEAREST in step with y so the boat shrinks as it moves away; the shoreline is at y~290, so the hull never goes above y 345
boat.note: the old path used the sprite centre at full size, so the boat top reached y 279 against the ruins and looked like it was climbing

6.direction: slow pan left to right so each party member gets their beat, then the title fades in

title.place: centred at y 60 on shot 6, fade in over 1.5 s
